abstracts.abstract: Establishes a wastewater infrastructure and drinking water program for the purpose of making payments toward the replacement and rehabilitation of existing local municipally-owned and funded drinking water, storm water and sanitary sewer systems; makes an appropriation therefor of $5,000,000.

bill.title: Relates to the wastewater infrastructure and drinking water program; appropriation

action.description: AMEND (T) AND RECOMMIT TO ENVIRONMENTAL CONSERVATION

posted_text:
💧 Environment & Climate
NY A9325 — NY Establishes $5M Program for Water Systems

New York is creating a $5 million program to help local governments replace and rehabilitate drinking water, storm water, and sanitary sewer systems. The program will offer grants for initial planning of Clean Water State Revolving Fund projects and can be used for engineering reports, environmental reviews, and upgrades to systems addressing issues like nutrient removal or failing septic systems. ...
